SSH config generation regression: setup_ssh_config.ps1 YAML parsing became over-strict and rejected valid YAML with inline comments (e.g., `aliases: []  # comment`), blocking config updates.
entries.context: Root cause: custom schema-aware line parser did not normalize/strip inline comments for unquoted scalars and list shorthands. This surfaced after adding noisy tracing to pinpoint a prior hang. Fix: Parse-Scalar now strips inline comments for unquoted values; list-key handling normalizes values through Parse-Scalar before checking for `[]` or empty.
entries.resolution: Updated parser to tolerate `[]` with trailing comments while preserving schema validation; keeps generation non-hanging and fail-fast with line numbers for true structural errors.

entries.issue: Meta-framework change initiated: proposing and documenting new `AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION` mode (repo-local allowlisted autonomous commands) and adding corresponding feature flags + audit requirements.
entries.context: Tracked for traceability because this is a CRITICAL governance surface change. See ADR-007 and AI_DECISION_LOG entry for details.
entries.resolution: ADR created (ADR-007), framework updated with new mode + guardrails, flags extended for explicit unlock and autonomous execution gating; constraints regenerated.

entries.issue: Systemic governance friction identified: strict allowlist + wrapper enforcement for AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION introduced new failure modes and slowed output-driven debug loops. Simplified approach adopted per VOC/CTQ to restore repo-local iteration speed while preserving infra boundary.
entries.context: Root cause: enforcement mechanism complexity (wrapper/quoting/parameter binding) exceeded its value during active debugging. Fix: ADR-008 updates mode definition to allow repo-local execution under flags, deny rules, timeouts, non-interactive enforcement, and audit logging—without mandatory wrapper allowlisting.
entries.resolution: Created ADR-008 (VOC/CTQ + 5-Why). Updated meta-framework to remove mandatory allowlist requirement for AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION and mark wrapper executor as deprecated/experimental. Regenerated constraints.
